div.div:
Outbound CDC only. Review consumes no events — it publishes ReviewCreatedEvent on INSERT and ReviewUpdatedEvent on MODIFY, and the average rating is aggregated by catalogview-review-sync-consumer.
Rating aggregation left Catalog — the old catalog-review-created-consumer (ADR-0011 §4) no longer exists; ReviewCreatedEvent never touches the products table.
